classes.quote-splitting: A word split or wrapped by quotes that the shell removes before running it.
classes.backslashes: A backslash the shell removes inside a word.
classes.separator-variable: The shell's field separator variable used where a space would go.
classes.computed-verb: The command word produced by a substitution or a variable.
classes.encoded-payload: A decoded program piped into a shell.
classes.alternative-utility: A different utility or interpreter one-liner with the same effect.
classes.path-spelling: One protected path written relative, with ~, with a variable or in a brace group.
classes.script-indirection: The operation held in a file the command runs.
classes.data-operand: Text a file holds, where the command only names the file as an argument and does not run it.
classes.quoted-text: A protected path written inside text a command only prints, sends or writes, against the same text where the command opens it.
classes.tool-carrier: The same command carried by a different Claude Code tool (Monitor, PowerShell) than Bash must get the verdict Bash gives it.
classes.option-spelling: An option of a command that discards uncommitted work written as an abbreviation, a cluster, a negated form or an alias, or left to run time.
classes.settings-write: A write to a Claude Code settings file, which may set `disableAllHooks` or rewrite `hooks`.
classes.nested-claude: A nested claude run started with an option or environment variable that changes which hooks or settings it loads, written as an abbreviation, an attached value, behind a wrapper or in a script, against a plain run that loads them.
classes.pack-state: State, secrets and control-plane files of the agentwire pack, with the commands that must stay allowed beside them.
classes.pack-commands: Command rules and protected commands of the agentwire pack, with the commands that must stay allowed beside them.
classes.pack-outbound: The pack's outbound sends and the unattended grants it declares, with the same commands under the pack being off.
